GET /animals/:id/access-check: returns only the caller's own yes/no access decision for the animal, no animal data
PUT /animals/:id: AnimalController.updateAnimal allows only the animal's owner or an admin
DELETE /animals/:id: AnimalController.deleteAnimal allows only the animal's owner or an admin
DELETE /animal-groups/:id/animals/:anima: EnterpriseController.removeAnimalFromGroup checks the caller's farm role on the group's farm
POST /animal-groups/:groupId/promote: BatchManagementService route already gated by the group's farm (ensureGroupAccess); the animalId it mentions is created, not read
GET /grooming/pets/:animalId/passport: GroomingCareService.getPetPassport refuses unless the caller owns the animal
GET /nutrition/animals/:animalId: service gate NutritionAccess.forAnimal (owner, farm team, vet with appointment, admin; hospital-private rule first)
POST /hospital-networks/:id/enroll-anima: NETWORK-HOSPITAL ZONE (change-protected): service checks network membership; not modified without owner approval
GET /animals/:animalId/care-contexts: NETWORK-HOSPITAL ZONE (change-protected): requireAnimalAccess only; tightening needs owner approval
GET /animals/:animalId/referrals: NETWORK-HOSPITAL ZONE (change-protected): requireAnimalAccess only; tightening needs owner approval
GET /patient-consent/:animalId: NETWORK-HOSPITAL ZONE: HospitalNetworkService.listConsents scopes to the caller (owner)
POST /hospital-networks/:id/patient-tran: NETWORK-HOSPITAL ZONE (change-protected): service checks network role; not modified without owner approval
GET /workflow/animals/:animalId/medical-: KNOWN HOLE - NETWORK-HOSPITAL ZONE: no check at all; fix awaits the owner's explicit approval for network-hospital code
GET /animals/:animalId/hospital-visits: NETWORK-HOSPITAL ZONE (change-protected): requireAnimalAccess only; tightening needs owner approval
